verif.title: 🔒 Private verification (optional)
verif.intro: Ask things only the real owner would know. Your answers are stored separately, are never shown on the public page and are never visible to claimants. When someone claims the item, the server compares their answers with yours and shows you a match score. A high score helps your decision; it is not proof of ownership.
verif.question: Question {{n}}
verif.qPlaceholder: e.g. What was the phone’s wallpaper?
verif.hintText: Compared exactly (ignoring capitals, spaces and punctuation).
verif.hintNumber: Compared as a number. ৳ and commas are ignored; Bangla digits work.
verif.hintFuzzy: Compared by key words. Close answers count as approximate, never as a full match.
verif.noAuto: No automatic score for this claim: the report has no stored private answers. Compare the claimant’s answers with what you know. Status: {{status}}.
verif.disclaimer: A high score is a signal, not proof. Ask for more evidence if unsure, and hand items over in a safe public place.
verif.reqText: Ask for something only the real owner could provide (a receipt, a photo of the item before it was lost, a serial number). {{name}} is notified and replies here; chat opens after you approve.
verif.reqHint: {{n}}/500 · do not share the correct answers
verif.reqSent: Request sent. The claimant has been notified.

chat.confirmDeleteChat:

chat.noneText: A private chat opens automatically when a claim is approved, so you can arrange the handover.
chat.pickText: Select a chat to start talking.
chat.lastActivity: Last activity {{time}}. Never share card numbers or passwords in chat.

detail.submitted: Submitted. The finder will review your answers.
detail.qIntro: Answer the finder’s private questions. Only the finder sees your answers, and you submit them once, so answer carefully. You will not be shown whether they were right.
detail.noQIntro: The finder did not set private questions. Explain why this item is yours, with details only the owner would know.
detail.blankHint: Leave a question blank if you do not know it: blank answers count as unanswered and can never raise your match.
detail.elseOpt: Anything else that shows it is yours? (optional)
detail.proofHint: Receipts, serial numbers, an older photo of the item. Visible only to the finder and stored privately.
detail.locked: Locked: a claim has been submitted, so the questions can no longer change.
detail.legacyQ: This report has questions but no stored answers, so claims need manual review. Add answers to get an automatic match score.
detail.legacyNone: No private questions. Add some so you can check claimants more reliably.
detail.notFoundText: It may have been removed or is no longer public.
detail.areaHintFound: The exact spot, where the item is held and the finder’s contact is only shared with the verified owner.
detail.areaHintLost: The exact spot is only shared with the verified owner.
